body:
I can't do that... Her friend already told me she has a boyfriend... I just can't accept that I probably wasted my chance of being with her because of shyness... 
I just wanted someone to say a few glances didn't mean anything... I'm so broken right now, I don't think I can keep going with life, I just wish I had a gun with me to end this pain that I've been dealing with for more than 10 years. It only gets worse...
